actions.action: Add a keyboard-operated “Move to position” command.
actions.mechanism: An explicit destination moves an item anywhere in the 40-item list without repeated dragging or stepping.
actions.implementation: Open a labeled form from each item’s button; accept positions 1–40. On confirmation, reorder existing IDs, record undo, and retain focus.
actions.check: Using only the keyboard, move item 37 to position 2; verify its ID, announced position, focus, and successful undo.
actions.risk: Clarify that positions describe the final order; reject invalid entries.

actions.action: Offer a keyboard move mode for nearby adjustments.
actions.mechanism: A focused item moves one place per arrow press, with an explicit commit or cancel.
actions.implementation: Enter through a “Reorder” button. Use arrows to preview order, Enter to commit one undoable change, and Escape to cancel; preserve IDs.
actions.check: Move an item three places, commit, then undo. Separately cancel a preview; verify unchanged order and focus. Test both list boundaries.
actions.risk: Intercept arrows only in move mode; announce instructions and position.

actions.action: Keep undo available throughout the page’s lifetime.
actions.mechanism: A page-scoped history restores earlier ID sequences rather than attempting to reverse drag coordinates or recreate items.
actions.implementation: Before every committed reorder, including dragging, save the ordered IDs. Provide a keyboard-accessible “Undo reorder” button; retain history across component remounts without expiry.
actions.check: Perform multiple moves through different controls, navigate within the page, then undo each; compare every restored sequence and ID set.
actions.risk: If deletion is supported, define reconciliation for IDs absent during undo.
